column7: CopySecret and CopyEnvironmentSecrets, authorized for the source's project only, answered "environment N not found" (or a raw storage not-found) for a missing target environment and "must be in the same project" for one in another project, so a caller could tell which environment IDs exist in projects they cannot see. Both now get the same refusal; a genuine storage failure still propagates. AUTHZ-ORACLE-1 item 2 sweep
